description: One template with its body, its named assets and the placeholders it contains. Required: template_id or key. Optional: with_body (default true — pass false when you only need to know what it expects; a template body with images inlined is megabytes).

template_id.description: ID of the template to read

with_body.description: Include the template body (default true); false returns only what it expects

name: get_document_template
